name: manual_2c0322
claim: In append-only event stores governed by long-term compliance mandates (such as E1 Section 13.3 seven-year retention), pruning the active hot store (e.g. issuer_events) must strictly MOVE pruned rows below the consumer acknowledgement horizon into a cold audit archive table or file. Pruned rows must never be deleted or discarded, preserving verifiable event history from genesis while bounding hot query indexes.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: Wire lines 142-145 and E1 13.3 require seven-year chain retention. Claude review row 5256 caught draft language implying pruned events were deleted; pruning moves rows to the cold audit archive, never discarding them.
